name: Generate Depreciation - Companies Act (Monthly)
description: Computes and posts pro-rata monthly Schedule II (Companies Act) depreciation per capitalized asset (SLM/WDV), accounting for additions, transfers and disposals occurring during the period. ASSUMPTIONS (no user available to confirm - see OPEN QUESTIONS): (1) FINANCIAL_YEAR is the calendar year the FY STARTS (e.g. 2025 = FY 2025-04-01 to 2026-03-31, Indian convention); PERIOD_MONTH is the calendar month number 1-12 (4=April...3=March of the following calendar year). (2) A 'capitalized' asset is identified via ar.CAPITALIZATION_DATE IS NOT NULL alone; an approved-disposal asset is still generated for its disposal month and excluded once disp.disposal_date < the period start. (3) Depreciation basis is the ASSET'S OWN per-asset editable COMPANIES_ACT_USEFUL_LIFE_YEARS / COMPANIES_ACT_METHOD / COMPANIES_ACT_RESIDUAL_VALUE_PCT fields on FAM_ASSET_REGISTER, NOT a join to FAM_DEP_RATE_CA_MASTER (that master's CATEGORY_CODE values do not overlap with FAM_ASSET_REGISTER/FAM_ASSET_CATEGORY_MASTER's codes). (4) Put-to-use date = GREATEST(CAPITALIZATION_DATE, confirmed FAM_ASSET_INSTALLATION.INSTALLATION_DATE where STATUS='CONFIRMED'). (5) WDV monthly rate = the Schedule-II-implied annual rate 1-(residual_value_pct/100)^(1/useful_life_years), divided by 12 (linear) then pro-rated by days_used/days_in_month. (6) ADDITIONS_DURING_MONTH / DISPOSALS_DURING_MONTH hold the asset's TOTAL_CAPITALIZED_COST when its put-to-use / approved-disposal date falls inside the period, else 0 - one row per asset per month. (7) Opening WDV = prior period's posted (status=APPROVED) CLOSING_WDV for the same asset; with no prior posted period it falls back to a legacy-asset-aware baseline (see (8)). (8) LEGACY ASSET OPENING WDV BASELINE: FAM_ASSET_REGISTER carries OPENING_ACCUMULATED_DEPRECIATION (NUMBER) and OPENING_WDV_AS_ON_DATE (DATE, optional) for assets already being depreciated before this system went live. A per-asset PROCESSING_START_ANCHOR = GREATEST(put_to_use_date, OPENING_WDV_AS_ON_DATE + 1 day) when OPENING_WDV_AS_ON_DATE IS NOT NULL, else put_to_use_date; this anchor drives both eligibility and the days_used pro-ration, so a legacy asset is never depreciated for any period on or before its OPENING_WDV_AS_ON_DATE. The bootstrap-fallback baseline (used only when no prior posted period exists) = total_capitalized_cost - opening_accumulated_depreciation when opening_wdv_as_on_date is set and the period starts after it, else total_capitalized_cost. (9) 'Period cannot be regenerated once posted' is enforced by an ALREADY_POSTED S-calc plus a blocking validation. (10) The FRS workflow (Generate/Edit/Submit-for-approval/Approve & Post/Cancel, plus 'Close Financial Year') is approximated within General Process capabilities: Generate = run + preview grid (execution_mode edit), Execute persists the row and setting STATUS=APPROVED is the 'Approve & Post' action; 'Close Financial Year' is not implemented (no such G-object capability). (11) The task brief's ask to also update FAM_ASSET_REGISTER.TOTAL_ACCUMULATED_DEPRECIATION on Approve & Post cannot be built here: that column does not exist on FAM_ASSET_REGISTER, and a General Process (persist_mode) writes to exactly one target only (OPEN QUESTION below). SOURCE_SQL / CALCULATIONS SPLIT (current): already_posted and opening_wdv - and everything computed from opening_wdv (wdv_monthly_dep, monthly_depreciation_amount_raw, monthly_depreciation_amount, closing_wdv, accumulated_depreciation) - live in the calculations[] array as S/E calc entries, NOT in source_sql. already_posted and opening_wdv are S-type calc entries whose SQL text references the process's own target table fam_dep_companies_act_register (self-referencing 'already posted' guard + prior-period closing_wdv carry-forward, with the legacy-asset baseline above as the opening_wdv fallback); this structured-S-calc placement IS what the engine's self-reference detector (backend/app/services/genprocess/service.py::_self_referencing_target, a case-insensitive regex over S-calc calc_expression text / builtin-validation table fields) scans for, and it correctly makes run_pipeline call table_persist.ensure_target_table() to pre-create the empty target table on every Refresh - this part of the mechanism was verified working. RESOLVED BUG (root cause of the 'relation ... does not exist' failure seen even after this restructuring): target_table/the self-reference SQL had been written in UPPER CASE (FAM_DEP_COMPANIES_ACT_REGISTER). This project's Postgres DB deploys/folds all identifiers to lower case; table_persist._create_table_sql() quotes target_table VERBATIM (preserving whatever case the model gives it), so an upper-case target_table produced a quoted, case-preserved table literally named "FAM_DEP_COMPANIES_ACT_REGISTER" - while every unquoted reference to it (this S-calc's SQL text, and table_persist._existing_columns()'s own information_schema lookup, which lower()s the name before comparing) resolves/folds to lower-case fam_dep_companies_act_register and so never finds that object. The pre-create WAS firing on every Refresh; it just kept creating a same-looking-but-different-cased table that nothing else could see, reproducing an identical-looking 'relation does not exist' error on the very next line that reads it. FIX: target_table and every self-reference in the S-calc SQL text are now lower_case (fam_dep_companies_act_register), matching this project's deployed casing convention (see all other real tables here, e.g. fam_asset_register, fam_dep_rate_ca_master) - now CREATE TABLE and every unquoted reference resolve to the SAME physical relation. Every column that does NOT depend on opening_wdv (residual_value, depreciable_base, slm_monthly_dep, wdv_annual_rate, and all passthrough/period/eligibility columns, plus the constant literals adjustment_remarks/status) stays computed directly in source_sql's base0/step2/step3 CTEs, unaffected by this change.
source_sql: WITH params AS (SELECT CAST(?.financial_year.number AS INTEGER) AS fy, CAST(?.period_month.number AS INTEGER) AS pm, CASE WHEN CAST(?.period_month.number AS INTEGER) >= 4 THEN CAST(?.financial_year.number AS INTEGER) ELSE CAST(?.financial_year.number AS INTEGER) + 1 END AS period_calendar_year), period AS (SELECT fy, pm, make_date(period_calendar_year, pm, 1) AS period_start, CAST((make_date(period_calendar_year, pm, 1) + INTERVAL '1 month' - INTERVAL '1 day') AS DATE) AS period_end FROM params), eligible AS (SELECT ar.ASSET_CODE AS asset_code, ar.ASSET_NAME AS asset_name, ar.CATEGORY_CODE AS category_code, CAST(ar.TOTAL_CAPITALIZED_COST AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS total_capitalized_cost, ar.BRANCH_CODE AS branch_code, CAST(ar.COMPANIES_ACT_USEFUL_LIFE_YEARS AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS useful_life_years, ar.COMPANIES_ACT_METHOD AS depreciation_method, CAST(ar.COMPANIES_ACT_RESIDUAL_VALUE_PCT AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS residual_value_pct, GREATEST(ar.CAPITALIZATION_DATE, COALESCE(inst.confirmed_install_date, ar.CAPITALIZATION_DATE)) AS put_to_use_date, CASE WHEN ar.OPENING_WDV_AS_ON_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN GREATEST(GREATEST(ar.CAPITALIZATION_DATE, COALESCE(inst.confirmed_install_date, ar.CAPITALIZATION_DATE)), (ar.OPENING_WDV_AS_ON_DATE + INTERVAL '1 day')::date) ELSE GREATEST(ar.CAPITALIZATION_DATE, COALESCE(inst.confirmed_install_date, ar.CAPITALIZATION_DATE)) END AS processing_start_anchor, CAST(ar.OPENING_ACCUMULATED_DEPRECIATION AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS opening_accumulated_depreciation, ar.OPENING_WDV_AS_ON_DATE AS opening_wdv_as_on_date, disp.disposal_date AS disposal_date FROM FAM_ASSET_REGISTER ar LEFT JOIN (SELECT ASSET_CODE, MIN(INSTALLATION_DATE) AS confirmed_install_date FROM FAM_ASSET_INSTALLATION WHERE STATUS = 'CONFIRMED' GROUP BY ASSET_CODE) inst ON inst.ASSET_CODE = ar.ASSET_CODE LEFT JOIN (SELECT ASSET_CODE, DISPOSAL_DATE FROM FAM_ASSET_DISPOSAL WHERE STATUS = 'APPROVED') disp ON disp.ASSET_CODE = ar.ASSET_CODE WHERE ar.CAPITALIZATION_DATE IS NOT NULL AND ar.ASSET_TYPE = 'FIXED_ASSET' AND (?.branch_code.string = 'ALL' OR ar.BRANCH_CODE = ?.branch_code.string)), base0 AS (SELECT p.fy AS financial_year, p.pm AS period_month, e.asset_code AS asset_code, e.asset_name AS asset_name, e.category_code AS category_code, e.total_capitalized_cost AS total_capitalized_cost, e.useful_life_years AS useful_life_years, e.depreciation_method AS depreciation_method, e.residual_value_pct AS residual_value_pct, e.put_to_use_date AS put_to_use_date, e.processing_start_anchor AS processing_start_anchor, e.opening_accumulated_depreciation AS opening_accumulated_depreciation, e.opening_wdv_as_on_date AS opening_wdv_as_on_date, e.disposal_date AS disposal_date, p.period_start AS period_start, p.period_end AS period_end, (p.period_end - p.period_start + 1) AS days_in_month, GREATEST(p.period_start, e.processing_start_anchor) AS effective_start_date, LEAST(p.period_end, COALESCE(e.disposal_date, p.period_end)) AS effective_end_date, (LEAST(p.period_end, COALESCE(e.disposal_date, p.period_end)) - GREATEST(p.period_start, e.processing_start_anchor) + 1) AS days_used, CASE WHEN e.put_to_use_date BETWEEN p.period_start AND p.period_end THEN e.total_capitalized_cost ELSE 0.0 END AS additions_during_month, CASE WHEN e.disposal_date BETWEEN p.period_start AND p.period_end THEN e.total_capitalized_cost ELSE 0.0 END AS disposals_during_month FROM eligible e CROSS JOIN period p WHERE e.processing_start_anchor <= p.period_end AND (e.disposal_date IS NULL OR e.disposal_date >= p.period_start)), step2 AS (SELECT b0.*, (b0.total_capitalized_cost * b0.residual_value_pct / 100.0) AS residual_value, (b0.total_capitalized_cost - (b0.total_capitalized_cost * b0.residual_value_pct / 100.0)) AS depreciable_base FROM base0 b0), step3 AS (SELECT s.*, CASE WHEN s.useful_life_years > 0 THEN (s.depreciable_base / s.useful_life_years / 12.0) * (CAST(s.days_used AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / s.days_in_month) ELSE 0.0 END AS slm_monthly_dep, CASE WHEN s.useful_life_years > 0 THEN 1.0 - POWER(s.residual_value_pct / 100.0, 1.0 / s.useful_life_years) ELSE 0.0 END AS wdv_annual_rate FROM step2 s) SELECT s.financial_year, s.period_month, s.asset_code, s.asset_name, s.category_code, s.total_capitalized_cost, s.useful_life_years, s.depreciation_method, s.residual_value_pct, s.put_to_use_date, s.disposal_date, s.period_start, s.period_end, s.days_in_month, s.effective_start_date, s.effective_end_date, s.days_used, s.additions_during_month, s.disposals_during_month, s.opening_wdv_as_on_date, s.opening_accumulated_depreciation, s.residual_value, s.depreciable_base, s.slm_monthly_dep, s.wdv_annual_rate, '' AS adjustment_remarks, 'DRAFT' AS status FROM step3 s

calculations.calc_expression: select CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fam_dep_companies_act_register t WHERE t.financial_year = ? AND t.period_month = ? AND t.asset_code = ? AND t.status = 'APPROVED') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END : financial_year,period_month,asset_code

select COALESCE((SELECT t2.closing_wdv FROM fam_dep_companies_act_register t2 WHERE t2.asset_code = ? AND t2.status = 'APPROVED' AND ((? = 4 AND t2.financial_year = ? - 1 AND t2.period_month = 3) OR (? <> 4 AND t2.financial_year = ? AND t2.period_month = ? - 1))), CASE WHEN NULLIF(?, '') IS NOT NULL AND ? > NULLIF(?, '') THEN ? - COALESCE(NULLIF(?, '')::numeric, 0.0) ELSE ? END) : asset_code,period_month,financial_year,period_month,financial_year,period_month,opening_wdv_as_on_date,period_start,opening_wdv_as_on_date,total_capitalized_cost,opening_accumulated_depreciation,total_capitalized_cost
if((opening_wdv - monthly_depreciation_amount_raw) < residual_value, if((opening_wdv - residual_value) > 0.0, opening_wdv - residual_value, 0.0), monthly_depreciation_amount_raw)
if((opening_wdv - monthly_depreciation_amount) < residual_value, residual_value, opening_wdv - monthly_depreciation_amount)

validations.name: period not already posted
validations.message: Financial year {form.financial_year} period {form.period_month} for asset {form.asset_code} is already Approved & Posted; this period cannot be re-generated

validations.name: valid depreciation method
validations.message: Depreciation method for asset {form.asset_code} must be SLM or WDV

validations.name: closing WDV not below residual value
validations.message: Closing WDV for asset {form.asset_code} cannot be negative

validations.name: valid status
validations.message: Status for asset {form.asset_code} must be one of DRAFT, PENDING_APPROVAL, APPROVED or CANCELLED
